map.各独立分量平方和开方。: The square root of the sum of squared independent components.
map.合成不确定度计算器将各独立不确定度分量按平方和开方合成，适合测量系统总不确定度评: The combined uncertainty calculator takes the square root of the sum of squares of independent uncertainty components, which suits overall measurement system uncertainty evaluation and traceability in test reports.
map.独立分量方差直接相加；相关时需加协方差项。: Variances of independent components simply add; when correlated a covariance term is required.

map.由各分量不确定度与自由度求有效自由度: Effective degrees of freedom from component uncertainties and degrees of freedom
